phase: frozen before reading author target artifacts or any campaign oracle
arithmetic: exact integer, Boolean and finite set equality; no tolerance
representation: Fresh directed parent/child graph with labelled ordinary leaves and optional labelled unary rho root. Minimal embeddings are unions of undirected graph paths between block labels; roots keep original orientation. Restriction suppresses only unlabelled unary vertices.
corruptions: Force rotation optimum from 2 to 1; comparator must reject
Omit vertex-disjointness on crossing partition; corrupted checker must incorrectly accept while clean checker rejects
Replace clean partition by crossing partition; gate must reject
pilot: n=3 and n=4 exact cuts and partitions; record times. Larger search only after projected wall clock below 120 seconds.
hostile_search: After controls pass: cut versus partition optima for all ordered pairs on up to 4 ordinary leaves with true labelled unary rho; test root-safe exchange and A2BC exchange premise on exact optimal cut sets. Audit finite shape/branch semantics independently before opening algorithm.py/reference.py.
fail_conditions: Any exact mismatch stops the corresponding leg; any target artifact weaker than universal proof must be scoped; a source expression undefined at root is a domain omission unless a well-defined execution yields a wrong answer.
lean_controls: Replay exact seven lemmas with clean standard dependencies; print axioms. Prove a true arithmetic twin with the same proof machinery and demand rejection of a false arithmetic variant; nonzero exit from missing imports is invalid evidence.
